items.exampleEn: I never doubted the sincerity of her apology.
items.exampleZh: 我從不懷疑她道歉的誠意。

items.exampleEn: He walked confidently onto the stage.
She looked at her newborn son with great tenderness.
items.exampleZh: 她滿懷溫柔地看著剛出生的兒子。

items.exampleEn: We were astonished to see snow in April.
items.exampleZh: 四月看到下雪，我們都很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: Many readers sympathized with the main character of the novel.
items.exampleZh: 許多讀者都同情那本小說的主角。

items.exampleEn: The band became famous for its rebellious songs.
items.exampleZh: 那個樂團以叛逆的歌曲聞名。

items.exampleEn: The two brothers had a quarrel about money.
items.exampleZh: 那兩兄弟為了錢吵了一架。

items.exampleEn: Please be truthful with me, even if the news is bad.
items.exampleZh: 就算是壞消息，也請對我說實話。

items.sentenceEn: My parents rarely quarrel, but when they do, it's about the TV.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸媽很少吵架，要吵也都是為了電視。

items.audioEn: Everyone in the stadium was astonished when the youngest player scored the winning goal.
items.audioZh: 年紀最小的球員踢進致勝一球時，全場觀眾都很驚訝。
options: They laughed at the youngest player

items.sentenceEn: She spoke confidently, even though it was her first interview.
items.sentenceZh: 雖然是第一次面試，她說話仍然很有自信。

items.sentenceEn: The old gardener treated every plant with tenderness.
items.sentenceZh: 那位老園丁溫柔地對待每一株植物。

items.stemEn: A good witness must be ____ and tell exactly what happened.
items.stemZh: 好的證人必須誠實，準確說出發生了什麼事。

items.stemEn: I really ____ with her; losing a pet is very sad.
items.stemZh: 我真的很同情她，失去寵物是很難過的事。

items.passageEn: When my cousin was fifteen, she was quite rebellious. She often had quarrels with her parents about her clothes and her late nights. One evening, she came home very late. Instead of making excuses, she listened to her conscience and was completely truthful about where she had been. Her parents were astonished. They could hear the sincerity in her voice, so instead of shouting, they talked calmly. She says that night changed their relationship.
items.passageZh: 我的表親十五歲時相當叛逆。她常為了穿著和晚歸跟爸媽吵架。有一天晚上她很晚才回家。她沒有找藉口，而是聽從良心，老老實實說出自己去了哪裡。她爸媽非常驚訝。他們聽得出她語氣中的真誠，所以沒有大吼，而是冷靜地談。她說那一晚改變了他們之間的關係。

questions.questionZh: 作者的表親晚歸那天做了什麼？
options: 老實說出自己去了哪裡

items.promptZh: 她自信地回答了所有的問題。
referenceEn: She answered all the questions confidently.
She confidently answered every question she was asked.
rubricZh: 要用 confidently 修飾動詞（例如 answered … confidently）
confidently 可放動詞前或句尾，例如 confidently answered、answered … confidently 等
「所有的問題」可寫，例如 all the questions、every question 等

items.promptZh: 她聲音中的溫柔讓大家都平靜下來。
referenceEn: The tenderness in her voice made everyone calm down.
Everyone calmed down because of the tenderness in her voice.
rubricZh: tenderness 當名詞（例如 the tenderness in her voice 等）
「平靜下來」可寫，例如 calm down、feel calm 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 made、makes 等）
